description: Indicative 2026 UK skip hire price ranges (low, median, high in GBP) per skip size for a Rent-a-Skip town or a postcode area. Provide exactly one of town_slug or postcode_area. Prices are confirmed on the booking call with a vetted local operator.

postcode_area.description: UK postcode area letters, for example "BA" or "M". A district or full postcode is reduced to its area.

town_slug.description: Rent-a-Skip town slug, for example "westbury" or "milton-keynes". Use check_coverage to find one.
